runtimeComparisons.frameCountScope: Both builds: low-level PCM frames or resampled engine output frames, including own/cross-state/reset continuations; wrapper self-check frames excluded. Engine source frames are intentionally not counted as output frames.
limits: Native YM2610B PCM runs at clock/16 with fixed prescaling; YM2610B enables physical FM0/3 in addition to YM2610 physical FM1/2/4/5. Engine cases separately report output rate and averaging/holding.
Cross-build raw states are tested for these exact builds only; opaque public snapshots remain owner-restricted.

The public wrapper has no setHooks API; the harness records actual synchronous bus/read calls and status/IRQ at chunk boundaries, without adding a production hook API. Cross-build states are exchanged only within the same chip variant.
No Worklet scheduling, physical hardware, browser, Native backend, Mixer or listening judgement is tested.

record.reviewScope: Independent read-only review of final checker plus artifact report/counter verification; reviewer did not edit checker or production code.
reviewedInvariants: Both variants are created separately; YM2610 physical FM0/3 excluded; all four available physical channels audible. YM2610B all six channels audible.
clock/16 native rate checked for both variants; Engine44100/48000/96000/1000000 paths cover downsample averaging and upsample holding.
ROM A/B independence, sparse offsets/resize/clear and serialized variable lengths checked;16MiB final two-byte boundary tested separately for both banks on YM2610B.
Own restore clears both ROMs and overwrites A before restore. Raw cross-build restore exchanges only same-variant snapshots. Public snapshots remain owner-restricted.
Checkpoints saved for both layouts; continuation/own/raw-cross/reset checks applied on regular layout. Fields distinguish checkpointSaved and continuationReplayTested.
Actual synchronous bus writes, reads/status/statusHi/IRQ compared at chunk boundaries. No public setHooks API invented; YM2610 data reads are observational.
Main output-frame/render counts and separately reported wrapper self-check frame totals independently recomputed.
ADPCM-A six individual EOS bits and ADPCM-B EOS, flag clear/mask/unmask/retrigger occur positively in bounded extra checks; B repeat continues audibly past two end wraps without EOS.

resolvedFindings.issue: Short main ADPCM-A/B scenarios program end/repeat controls without positively reaching ROM end.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Bounded256-byte reference checks: A6voices20000frames twice; B6000frames twice; status assertions, mask/clear/rearm; B10000frame repeat proves >=2wraps, EOSclear and audibletail. Additional262032rawframes perbackendvariant are separately counted.

limits: Exact output agreement tests these fixed builds, not original-hardware accuracy.
No physical listening/Native device. Browser Worklet captures are a separate8route report.
